LLM-Assisted Analysis

All 14 Webots integration tests passed

Provider: deepseek · Model: deepseek-chat · Generated On: 2026-07-02T12:29:53+00:00 · Stage: success · Confidence: high

This commit adds LLM-assisted CI report diagnostics. All 14 scenarios (3 builtin, 7 cap, 4 flow) passed with 100% rate. The pipeline exercised camera/lidar snapshots, SLAM map saving, memory roundtrip, speech synthesis, voiceprint listing, exploration with timeout/cancel, fault recovery, object navigation, and patrol observe. No regressions detected.

PR Changes

  • Adds LLM-assisted report diagnostics for CI
  • Introduces testing infrastructure (scenarios, report generation, fake VLM)
  • Adds system components: atlas, executor, pilot, liaison, scene, scribe
  • Adds services: memsearch, speech, voiceprint
  • Adds primitives: camera, chassis, lidar, audio
  • Adds tools: rbnx CLI, codegen, robonix-api
  • Adds Webots simulation environment with Tiago robot
  • Adds CI workflows for testing, bot, docs check, issue/PR triage

Test Result

  • 14/14 scenarios passed: builtin (fault_recovery_builtin, file_roundtrip, run_command), cap (camera_snapshot, explore_smoke, lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list), flow (fault_recovery, object_navigation, patrol_observe). All leaf calls succeeded as expected, including intentional failures (missing file, invalid args, explore timeout) that were correctly handled.

Suggested Fix

  • No fix needed. Monitor the scene-graph-LLM warnings in scene.log (fake VLM returns empty responses) — these are expected with the fake VLM but should be addressed when a real VLM is integrated.

Risks Or Watchouts

  • Scene graph LLM requests to fake VLM return empty responses ("Expecting value: line 1 column 1") — expected but noisy
  • Explore skill timed out as designed (5s and 8s ceilings) — no issue
  • Voiceprint list returns 'db not initialised' — expected for first run
  • Nav2 controller_server logged 'Failed to make progress' during object_navigation but recovered successfully
